CustomField.description: Box folder ID that contains every governed contract folder. Configuration rather than a caller argument: a portfolio search has to be bounded, and the boundary is the org's to set. Box metadata search is enterprise-wide, so without this an unscoped query also returns documents from earlier demo environments carrying the same file names.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Box folder ID of the contracts root. Set per environment; not stored in source.
CustomField.label: Contracts Root Folder ID
